title: Twenty-One Day Timeline for Admitting Complaints

content.scenario: A consumer filed a complaint with the District Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The consumer is now waiting to hear whether the complaint will be admitted or rejected.
content.outcome: According to sub-section (2) of Section 36, the District Commission shall decide on the admissibility of the complaint within twenty-one days from the date on which the complaint was filed. If the complaint is admitted, the District Commission shall refer a copy of the complaint to the opposite party within twenty-one days from the date of admission.

user_queries: What is the timeline for admitting complaints under the Consumer Protection Act?
